h1: The Tubkaak Krabi — The Quietest Resort on Tubkaak Beach, with Island Views Front and Centre
intro: Drive past Ao Nang and Klong Muang almost to the end of the coast road and you reach a small, hushed stretch of sand called Tubkaak Beach — which many locals call the quietest corner on this shore. That's where The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort sits: a 5-star boutique resort that isn't large, but trades on privacy and a sweep of Andaman island views you simply won't get in busy Ao Nang. 59 contemporary Thai-style rooms and pool villas, from approximately ฿7,500/night.

body.html: The Tubkaak opened in 2003 and had a major refresh in 2017. The selling point every review keeps coming back to is its location on quiet, private Tubkaak Beach — the sand in front of the resort sees almost no passing strangers, because it sits right at the end of the Klong Muang coast road. Look out from the beach and you'll see islands scattered across the bay, Koh Hong among them, forming a backdrop that guests say is at its best at sunset.

All 59 rooms and pool villas are designed in a contemporary Thai style with timber and warm tones. The entry-level Garden Room at 45 sqm already feels generous; step up to the Premier Pool Villa and Ocean View Pool Villa and you get a private pool and a direct sea view. Guests consistently praise the comfortable beds and the spotless bathrooms, though there are gripes about limited storage space in the rooms, and some find the air-conditioning noisier than expected.
"Coffee outside the room each morning, looking at a sea with hardly anyone on it — and you understand exactly why they chose to build a resort at the far end of this beach."

Food is another area that scores well time after time. The resort has two beachfront restaurants — The Arundina for the breakfast buffet and Thai dishes, and Di Mare, a beachside Italian that many guests single out as the highlight: a romantic setting serving pasta and seafood with a sunset view. The one caveat is that on-resort prices run noticeably higher than restaurants outside, which is normal for a spot this far from town.

Beyond the beach and the food, there's the L'escape Spa with Thai treatments, yoga classes, kayaking, an outdoor pool and a small playground. Service is what reviews praise most — staff remember guests' names, pay attention to detail, and will arrange boat trips out to Koh Hong or Koh Poda. Being a mid-sized resort, the service feels warmer and more personal than at a big chain hotel.

To be straight with you, the thing to weigh up is the distance from Ao Nang. It's about 20–25 minutes by car from the resort to Ao Nang (the hub of restaurants, bars and island-tour piers), and roughly 40 minutes to Krabi Airport. If you want to eat out every meal or have a night out, that distance starts to bite. But if you've come to rest quietly by the beach, this is exactly what Tubkaak delivers better than the popular, crowded beaches.

With a 9.1 from 186 reviews on Trip.com and steady praise for service and privacy, The Tubkaak suits couples and anyone looking to escape the bustle. The tip is to book an Ocean View room or a Pool Villa if the budget allows, because the direct sea view is the main reason people come. On a tighter budget, the Garden Room still gets you the same quiet-beach atmosphere — you just walk to the water yourself.

honestSummary: The Tubkaak is the best pick for travellers who want a quiet, private beach and warm, personal service rather than to be in the middle of the tourist scene. The Andaman island views and the beachside Italian are what guests remember — but you do have to accept a location that's far from Ao Nang and reliant on a car.
honestChecks: If you want to walk out to eat, hit bars, or hop on island-tour boats easily — Tubkaak is at the end of the beach, 20–25 minutes from Ao Nang → a hotel in the Ao Nang area will be far more convenient.
If you're travelling with young kids who need lots of activities — this place is geared to quiet, couples-focused calm, not a big family resort → consider a resort with a water park or kids' club.
If you want a direct sea view from your room — the Garden Room faces the garden, not the sea → choose an Ocean View or Pool Villa, and book ahead in high season.

faqTitle: FAQ — The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort

faq.q: Where is The Tubkaak Krabi, and how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits on Tubkaak Beach in Nong Thale, Mueang Krabi, at the far end of the Klong Muang shore. It's about 20–25 minutes by car from Ao Nang and roughly 40 minutes from Krabi Airport (KBV). We recommend booking the resort transfer or renting a car, as Grab is scarce in this area.

faq.q: What does The Tubkaak Krabi cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿7,500/night for a Garden Room (45 sqm). Step up to the Premier Pool Villa and Ocean View Pool Villa, which have private pools, with the largest being the 250 sqm Haven Suite. Prices vary by season and package — always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is The Tubkaak Krabi best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for couples, honeymooners, and anyone who wants to escape the crowds and rest by a quiet beach. The mood is private and slow-paced. It's less suited to those who want nightlife or to eat out every meal, since it's fairly far from the Ao Nang area.

faq.q: What's the beach in front of the resort like — can you swim?
faq.a: Tubkaak is a quiet, private stretch of sand with views of the Andaman islands and Koh Hong. You can swim at high tide (at low tide the water retreats quite far). It's one of the best sunset-viewing spots on the Klong Muang shore.

faq.q: What are the resort restaurants like — is there a choice?
faq.a: There are two beachfront restaurants — The Arundina for the breakfast buffet and Thai food, and Di Mare, a beachside Italian that's the highlight. On-resort prices are higher than outside, but the seaside setting is worth it, especially for dinner at sunset.

faq.q: How far ahead should you book — and can you cancel?
faq.a: In high season (November–April), book 1–2 months ahead, especially the Ocean View rooms and Pool Villas, which sell out fast. Most platforms offer a Free Cancellation option — pick that if your plans aren't firm yet.
